scenes.title: Worked example: Gross 10%, 20% performance fee, 0.5% management…
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. Gross 10%, 20% performance fee, 0.5% management to 7.5% net. DIY instead, compounding weekly at $2 gas: $5,000 position: gas = $104 a year equals 2.08% drag to the vault probably wins. $500,000 position: gas equals 0.02% drag, while the vault's fees cost 2.5 points to DIY probably wins.

scenes.q: Why do vaults suit small positions?
scenes.a: They spread gas costs across all depositors.
